description:
You are holding the cube with white on top, green in front, and red on the right. The cube is fully scrambled.

The top face (white center): back row (left to right) is yellow, green, orange; middle row is yellow, white, blue; front row is yellow, orange, white.

The front face (green center): top row is orange, white, red; middle row is blue, green, yellow; bottom row is green, white, orange.

The right face (red center): top row is blue, orange, blue; middle row is all red; bottom row is blue, red, orange.

The bottom face (yellow center), looking up from below: front row (nearest the green face) is red, yellow, green; middle row is green, yellow, blue; back row (nearest the blue face) is red, green, white.

The left face (orange center): top row is red, blue, green; middle row is orange, orange, white; bottom row is white, yellow, yellow.

The back face (blue center), looking from behind: top row is yellow, red, blue; middle row is white, blue, green; bottom row is white, orange, green.

Solve the cube.
oracle_solution: F R2 D' F2 L2 U' F2 L2 U F2 L2 D2 L D B2 R2 F R' F L
